datasets.role: line survey, regions, moment maps, wings

recipe.description: Line list: Splatalogue (CDMS+JPL) via astroquery for the rest ranges 164.4-179.8, 251.2-268.1, 341.9-357.3 GHz, curated species + hydrogen RRLs from the Rydberg formula
Continuum survey of all 2D pbcor images: peaks >5 sigma, positions, rms (MAD)
Spectra extraction from all pbcor cubes: N, S nominal pixels, beam aperture (diameter = geometric-mean FWHM), r=2.5" and r=8" flux densities, cube-peak pixel
Systemic velocity from HCN/HCO+ first moments and half-maximum midpoints
Blind boxcar scan (300 and 100 km/s) at 5 sigma, forced photometry of all catalogue lines, overview and zoom plots; identification at |dv|<60 km/s with plausibility tiers
Moment maps (core |v|<350, blue -400..-150, red 150..400 km/s, mom1 3-sigma clipped), peak finding (>8 sigma, >=1 beam apart) to define regions

Region spectra (peak pixel within 0.6" of the nominal position, beam aperture), 1- and 2-Gaussian fits (scipy curve_fit, constant baseline, noise from line-free channels, lag-1 correlation inflation), integrated intensity |v|<350 with empirical box-sum noise, Tb (Rayleigh-Jeans)
Weak lines by matched filter with same-region HCN/HCO+ templates (limits 3 sigma); CS/H2CS/29SiO NNLS blend model; H13CN on CO wing

Round 2: wing reality tests, unified line table with template-matched integrated intensities and error budgets, spatial scatter tests, region velocities, continuum catalogue/common beam/alpha, cross-OUS check

results.value: At the common 5.84x3.52" beam (Xb4f native): N/S peak Xb4b 14.1/9.5, Xb4d 16.2/11.0, Xb4f 19.4/13.9, Xb47 43.4/27.2 mJy/beam: N/S = 1.4-1.6 at all matched beams, so the native 'S compact (S/N peak 3.3 at 0.24", N brighter at >=5.8")' is beam dilution of an N that is extended/multi-clump, plus ~43% of S flux being extended. Total flux (r<8", common beam): Xb4b 24, Xb4d 35, Xb4f 51, Xb47 91 mJy: the 0.25" and 0.94" arrays recover 48% and 68% of the Xb4f B6 flux (missing short spacings), so alpha built with them is biased high. Spectral indices (matched beam, noise + flux scale): total r<8" at 8.95x5.98" beam: alpha(B5-B6, Xb55-Xb4f) = 1.26+-0.27, alpha(B6-B7, Xb4f-Xb47) = 1.92+-0.38, alpha(B5-B7) = 1.54+-0.20; peak-based N: alpha(B5-B6)=1.6+-0.3, alpha(B6-B7)=2.5+-0.4 (Xb4f-Xb47), S: 1.4+-0.3, 2.1+-0.4 (N and S are merged in the Xb55 beam, so per-nucleus B5 indices are not meaningful). Using Xb4d or Xb4b as the B6 anchor gives alpha(B6-B7) 3-4.7 and alpha(B5-B6) 0.3 to -0.7: these are artefacts of resolved-out flux, not spectral properties. Defensible statement: alpha(B5-B7) ~1.5+-0.2 (flatter than pure dust, alpha~3.5-4, consistent with a free-free/synchrotron contribution at B5, e.g. Michiyama+2020 attribute part of the mm continuum to free-free) with a ~0.5 systematic from uv-coverage differences between OUS
results.uncertainty: alpha +-0.2-0.4 (noise+scale) plus ~0.5 systematic (uv coverage)

interpretation: The survey finds that the spectral content of the dataset is dominated by only a handful of lines: HCN and HCO+ 2-1/3-2/4-3 (very high S/N at both nuclei), CS 7-6 (N 15 sigma, S 7.5 sigma, Xb47), a CH3OH J_-1-J_0 E blend in Band 5, and the blue wing of CO 3-2 at the Xb47 spw20 edge. Everything else (SO 5_6-4_5, 253.97 GHz bump, HC3N 28-27, HC15N, SO 8_8-7_7, HCN-vib, H13CN) is absent or only marginal, so shock/chemistry diagnostics beyond CS, HCN/HCO+ ratios and CH3OH will be limits (Q4, Q5). The proposal's SO(6_5-5_4) is not in the data. The system is resolved at 0.25-1": N (double-horned, broad, extended continuum), S (compact continuum, line centre ~65 km/s blueward of systemic, narrower), a narrow Bridge component 1.4" S of N, two eastern clumps (E1, E2, redshifted 50-90 km/s), a western clump, and a blue-shifted blob (Sblue) 3" S-SW of S with a broad (120-230 km/s) blue-shifted profile and a blue wing; the S nucleus itself has a 4-9% blue wing. These match the picture of a dense-gas outflow near the S nucleus, but the high-velocity channels are outside the clean mask, so wing fluxes are lower limits/dirty. N and S are cleanly separable at Bands 6-7 (beam minor axes 2.7-3.5" << 5.2") and only partially in Band 5. HCN/HCO+ at matched J is already a regional discriminator (N 0.6-1.0, S 0.4-0.5 at J=3-2); this is handed to Q1 together with matched-beam convolution. The delivered mfs/cont images are line-free. ROUND 2: The S blue wing and the elongated (~2", ~0.4 kpc) blue-wing structure south of S are real (8-19 sigma vs empirical noise, reproduced by an independent array, not a sidelobe copy of S/N); this is the only dense-gas outflow candidate in the data and supports regional comparisons for S vs its wing, but with uncleaned (lower-limit) fluxes. N and S have different line-centre velocities (N-S +71 km/s), so a single systemic velocity is not appropriate. Of the weak lines only CH3OH (J=1-3 E blend, cold/sub-thermal, Trot<~11 K) and probably HOC+ 2-1 (HCO+/HOC+~37-50, N+S blend) are secure; SO 5_6-4_5, the 253.9 GHz feature and HC3N are unconfirmed at the 2-4 sigma level against baseline scatter. Continuum spectral index alpha(B5-B7)~1.5+-0.2 once beams and aperture are matched.
caveats: Formal errors are supplemented by an empirical baseline term (template slid over line-free channels) and spatial field scatter for tentative lines; flux-scale (5% B6, 10% B5/B7) and a 12 m Gaussian primary-beam term (5-10% for pb<0.9) are added only in the sig_cal column and in the text of the budgeted entries; absolute pb accuracy at E1/E2/W was not measured.

Single-Gaussian parameters (centroid, FWHM) are INVALID where chi2r>>1 (N and S at all resolutions: double-horned/two-component profiles, chi2r 2-20): such rows are flagged in the report; use the integrated intensity (template/sum) or the 2G components.

A single systemic velocity is not applicable: N 2792+-19, S 2721+-21 km/s (N-S offset +71+-28), midpoint ~2756; the 2780 km/s of round 1 is the blended low-resolution centre. Weak-line templates/windows are per region.

Wings and the Sblue structure are real in two independent arrays (Xb4d, Xb4b convolved) but lie outside the clean mask: fluxes are lower limits, with a sidelobe/missing-flux systematic <=0.01-0.02 Jy/beam km/s; the Xb4b HCN test has no power against sidelobes on its own.

SO 5_6-4_5, the 253.9 GHz feature and HC3N 28-27 are unconfirmed: single-beam (Xb4f) significance drops from 5.0/9.8/3.8 sigma to 2.8/4.2/2.0 sigma against the spatial scatter, and the non-detection at 1" and 0.25" is non-diagnostic because beam dilution of a smooth source would put the signal below the limits.

Continuum: 0.24" and 0.94" arrays resolve out extended flux (48%/68% of the 5.8" flux at B6), so comparisons of flux or alpha across OUS must use matched beams and are image-plane only; the defensible alpha(B5-B7)=1.5+-0.2 (+-0.5 systematic).
Line IDs from Splatalogue rest frequencies; blends with separation < line width (HCN v2=1, CS/H2CS/29SiO, CH3OH J=1-3, H13CN/CO) are degenerate; H13CN opacity cannot be measured from these data.
Distance 40 Mpc (literature) is assumed for pc conversions; literature outflow geometry (Michiyama+2018, Pereira-Santaella+2024) is quoted from abstracts only.

Literature: Michiyama+2018 (arXiv:1810.04821) abstract verified via arXiv API (outflow from S nucleus; N no detection); distance 40 Mpc (Pereira-Santaella+2024) and Nishimura+2024 were taken from earlier notes and not re-verified; the HOC+ literature ratios (Harada+2018 2018ApJ...855...49H, Usero+2004) could NOT be verified and were removed. CH3OH excitation is model dependent (blend degenerate; 30% window/template systematic).
